layer.note: Author A in the origin chunk, surveyed, with B listed as a co-builder. A shaft down column (5, *, 5), a Rustband beam at y 20 with one cell of Gibsonite, the cell (0, 0, 0) set to the extension id 300, and the cell (0, 31, 0), empty in the ground, written explicitly as 0: a change at the base value, which removes, for readers who rank A first, any block another layer placed there. The shaft's cells are written only where the ground was solid; elsewhere they are null, no change.

tags: <base64 of nonce || AES-256-GCM(region key, plaintext) || tag>

builder_keys.name: retired: every layer of the key is void, whenever written
retired, then named again: still void (a retirement is permanent)
all retires every key named before it
a key named after all is valid
named in the same second as all: void (the naming must be later)
a malformed builder tag names nothing

home.name: the twin of the spawn chunk
wrapping below 0 on an axis (an identity whose spawn chunk is the origin)

stack.note: Each case gives the chunk, the mutes and the layers, as {id, author, builder, created_at, cobuilders, changed: {cell index: value}}, the changed cells being already decoded (§5.4); the reader, its follows and its clock are the same for every case. For each cell: the value, the id of the winning layer and its rank, or null when no counted layer changed the cell, which then shows its base.

cases.name: strangers: the newest layer wins; a layer speaks only for the cells it changed
strangers with the same created_at: the lower author pubkey wins
a followed identity beats a newer stranger; among follows the newest wins
the reader beats everyone outside a home
inside the home cube the home owner beats the reader (spawn chunk)
inside the home cube the home owner beats the reader (corner chunk)
outside the home cube the home owner is an ordinary identity
the home does not reach the twin plane
mutes come first: a muted stranger and a muted home owner are gone
a layer dated more than 600 s past the reader's clock is not counted yet
one author, two builder keys: newest first, then the lower builder key
co-builders: where A placed, the layers A lists count at A's rank, and the newest among them wins
co-builders are not transitive
the home owner's co-builders share rank 1 in the owner's cells inside the home
a listed co-builder whose own rank is better keeps it
a co-builder undoes the builder: an explicit change at the base value (0 over empty ground) wins in the builder's cell
the list comes from the author's newest layer only: an older device's layer still listing B no longer lifts B
the cap (here 2 authors): authors by own rank, then newest layer, with no lifts; a lister left out lifts nobody

chunks.name: origin
chunks.note: The pinned chunk under revision 3. It is volcanic, so no cinder vent is drawn, and its Glowcore draw fails under both revisions: its ground is the revision 2 ground, byte for byte.

chunks.name: home
chunks.note: The home vector chunk (frozen) under revision 3.

chunks.name: pools
chunks.note: The pools chunk (dune, K 12) under revision 3: its cinder vent draw, just before Ferrovein, fails, but it reads four bytes, which shifts every draw after it.

chunks.name: vent-5
chunks.note: A frozen chunk with no Cinderrock under revision 2, and a cinder vent of five Cinderrock cells under revision 3.

chunks.name: vent-glowcore-k9
chunks.note: A karst chunk whose costliest cube is K 9: a cinder vent, and a Glowcore vein that revision 2 could not place (it needed K 10).

cases.name: one survey at revision 2
a revision 2 survey, then a newer client surveys at revision 3: the chunk keeps revision 2
surveyed is the first survey, carried forward: a revision 3 survey of 200 republished later still comes before a revision 2 survey of 300
rank first: a stranger who dates a survey 0 does not decide for a reader who follows an earlier-ranked surveyor
the same rank and the same surveyed second: the lower author pubkey decides
no counted survey: the base is empty
surveyed read from a plane: anything but a non-negative integer no later than created_at reads as created_at

mixed.note: In the vent-glowcore-k9 chunk, revision 2 and revision 3 grounds differ in the cells the cinder vent and the Glowcore vein (and the draws after them) touch. A revision 2 layer surveyed first, so the base is revision 2; a revision 3 layer mines one cell. That cell shows 0; every other cell shows the revision 2 ground, including cells where revision 3 would differ.
